I have farmed this land for many years using the seeds we keep from last season, and I do not have money to buy fertilizer or chemicals from the shop. This plot is small, so my family and I will do all the work ourselves—we cannot afford to hire anyone. We depend on the rains, and I plant cassava and beans together because they fill our bellies when times are hard.
